christopher-magomba--sua.notes: Agricultural economist. Scholar page says Lecturer, mapped to Assistant Professor under the UK-lecturer rule. Other sources conflict: an Illinois news item calls him a professor, and several profiles give different departments (Agricultural Economics and Agribusiness; Trade and Investment; School of Agricultural Economics and Business Studies), so unit is left null. PhD in agricultural economics from SUA is from a search snippet. Evidence is a Google Scholar profile, not a homepage or CV.
